Their eyes are focused on a small, dome‑shaped surveillance camera mounted in the ceiling near a play corner, while the other hand rests on the checklist, thumb lightly resting on a highlighted line (the camera‑installation clause). The checklist is visible enough to convey its presence but no legible text is shown. The composition places the owner on the left third, the camera on the right third, and the checklist bridging the two, emphasizing the connection between the regulatory document and the installed equipment. The overall lighting is natural and warm, with gentle shadows that give depth without drawing attention away from the focal elements. No signage, logos, or readable text appear in the scene.
